Context: "Ward" shall include-

## "Ward" shall include-  
- (i) a married daughter, working in an eligible office, irrespective of the fact that the retiring allottee is having a son, who is also employed in an eligible office, and he is in a position to maintain
- the parents;
- (ii) a daughter-in-law, working in an eligible office.
- Rule 50.
